title: Baby Ruth Byrne in Stroller, San Diego Yard - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Ruth O'CONNA BYRNE - 7 MO. - 4789- 70TH - - S.D. SEPT - 1937 115 PANEL-ART SNAPSHOTS REG. TRADEMARK APR 26 1938 BUNNELL PHOTO SHOP SAN DIEGO, CALIFORNIA Daughter of: Ruth Herrick Byrne And Daniel J. Byrne
description: A delightful black-and-white outdoor snapshot capturing seven-month-old O'Conna Byrne sitting in a wheeled baby stroller or walker beneath a young tree. Taken in September 1937 in San Diego, California, the scene showcases the sunny open residential landscape of late-Depression era Southern California. The baby wears a light outfit with a bow in her hair, smiling towards the camera. The back is stamped by Bunnell Photo Shop in San Diego with a processing date of April 26, 1938, alongside familial handwritten notations.
